questions.question: Why was Hakari suspended from Jujutsu High?
questions.subject: Kinji Hakari/Synopsis

answer.item: Afterward, Hakari got into disagreement with a conservative member of the jujutsu higher ups and beat them up leading to him being suspended as a result.

questions.question: What did Hakari do with his time after his suspension?
questions.subject: Kinji Hakari/Synopsis

answer.item: Sometime after he formed an underground fight club.

questions.question: Who told Megumi and Nobara that Hakari couldn't join the Kyoto Goodwill Event?
questions.subject: Kinji Hakari/Synopsis

answer.item: Maki mentions to Megumi and Nobara that Hakari had been suspended and can't participate in the Kyoto Goodwill Event.

questions.question: What does Hakari mean by the 'fever'?
questions.subject: Kinji Hakari/Synopsis

answer.item: The fever refers to people's addictive passions and Hakari wants to control all of Japan's fever with his fight club.

questions.question: How did Hakari defeat Charles Bernard in the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Kinji Hakari/Synopsis

answer.item: Hakari is given a bonus of infinite cursed energy and kicks directly through Charles's defenses, breaking G Warstaff and defeating the aspiring manga creator in one blow.

questions.question: How did Hakari survive Uraume freezing and punching off his arm?
questions.subject: Kinji Hakari/Synopsis

answer.item: Hakari's arm was then frozen and punched off by Uruame but due to the effects of Idle Death Gamble it quickly healed, he then launched Uraume into a building.

questions.question: What did Uraume do at the end of their fight with Hakari?
questions.subject: Kinji Hakari/Synopsis

answer.item: Uraume then chuckled at Hakari's comment and chose to kill themself.
